fusions.name: Bars Come Down
fusions.desc: Closes your scales in on every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and leaving each [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: No Way Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Your tail lashes the first enemy it meets, dealing 20 damage and leaving it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Palisade of Scutes
fusions.desc: Stands a wall of scales 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Latch Down
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 30% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
